manifest.configuration_1: Create a campaign, choose Agent or Dynamic Workflow mode, expand the question, then set cycles, interval, workers, and attended or unattended operation.
manifest.description: Runs multi-cycle research campaigns that keep working after you walk away. Give it a question and it expands that into a tree of narrower sub-questions, sends agents to investigate each one, and streams findings to the page as they land. A campaign self-drives until the question is answered or it notices progress has stalled, and you can hand the finished report off to your knowledge library or a shareable artifact.
manifest.highlight_1: Expands one broad question into a scoped tree of sub-questions before spending agent time
manifest.highlight_2: Campaigns keep researching between your check-ins, with findings streamed live
manifest.highlight_3: Notices when a campaign stops making progress instead of looping forever
manifest.highlight_4: Attended mode pauses to ask you a question when it needs a decision; unattended runs straight through
manifest.highlight_5: Add follow-up questions mid-campaign without starting over
manifest.highlight_6: Start, pause, and resume any campaign from the dashboard
manifest.highlight_7: Export the finished report to your knowledge library or a shareable artifact
manifest.use_case_1: Run a multi-cycle investigation that expands a broad question, streams evidence, and produces a reusable report.
